RULE_ABNORMAL_PROFIT_PATH.description: Transaction graph contains a short path with large positive normalized asset flow after protocol interaction.

RULE_ORACLE_READ_WRITE_SAME_TX.description: Transaction graph touches oracle role and trading/lending protocol roles in the same transaction.

RULE_EXCESSIVE_SLIPPAGE.description: Transaction graph or context reports slippage above the configured basis point threshold.

RULE_THIN_LIQUIDITY_TRADE.description: Transaction graph or context reports liquidity below the configured USD threshold.

RULE_FLASH_LOAN_PATH.description: Transaction graph contains flash-loan-like call signatures or same-asset in/out flow.

RULE_BASELINE_NO_RICH_EVIDENCE.description: Rule baseline ran but the graph has no transfer, call, or protocol role evidence.

FEATURE_TRACE_UNSUPPORTED.description: Trace source could not provide call tree or logs.
